Privacy Policy

Effective November 6, 2026.

This policy describes information collected through the John Crawford Company website and how to contact us about it.

Information you provide

When you send a form on this website, we receive the contact details and project information you enter. If you email us, we receive the contact information, project details and any photos or attachments you choose to send.

How your information is used

We use inquiry information to respond, discuss your project and provide the help you request. Our website providers also process information to operate and protect the website.

Website providers

Form submissions are kept in HighLevel, the customer relationship system we use to manage inquiries. This website is hosted through Netlify and, for the preview, ChatGPT Sites. Hosting providers may process technical information, such as IP addresses, browser details and request logs, to deliver and secure the website. Our forms use Cloudflare Turnstile to confirm that a person, not an automated program, is sending them; Cloudflare receives browser and device information for that check.

Embedded services and tracking

This website includes a Google Maps embed. Loading that map may allow Google to receive device and visit information and use its own cookies or similar technologies. Social profile links take you to separate services when you open them. Those providers' privacy practices apply to their services. See Google's Privacy Policy (opens in a new tab).

If you allow Targeting cookies in our cookie notice, we use the Meta Pixel (Meta Platforms) to measure our ads and to show our ads on Facebook and Instagram to people who visited this website. It records pages viewed and that a quote or appointment request was sent, never the details you type into a form. For visitors in California, we turn on Meta's Limited Data Use setting, which restricts how Meta may use this data. If you decline or later turn Targeting off in the cookie settings, the Meta Pixel does not run. We do not use audience-tracking analytics. To protect our advertising from fraudulent clicks, our pages also use ClickCease, a click-fraud detection service from CHEQ. It receives technical information about each visit, such as IP address, browser and device details, to identify automated or invalid ad clicks. Because it is a security measure, it runs for every visitor. A cookie notice from CookieScript lets you review and change your cookie choices; it saves your choice in a cookie on your device. The website does not change its behavior in response to browser Do Not Track signals. Embedded third-party services may follow their own tracking practices.

Your inquiry and privacy requests

To ask about access, correction or deletion of information you provided directly to us, email john@johncrawford.com or call (818) 884-5464. We may need to verify your request and retain records required for an ongoing project or by law.

You can also write to John Crawford Company, 22311 Ventura Blvd #101, Woodland Hills, CA 91364.

Policy updates

We will post changes on this page and update the effective date when this policy changes.
